groups.title: People
groups.note: Every person who authored or committed a commit on main, shown by GitHub login, plus the project owner.

members.name: MosheByte
members.role: Owner: sets direction, holds the accounts. Commits through this account are written by the agent and disclosed in their trailers.

groups.title: Agents
groups.note: Agents have no GitHub account of their own here. They act through the owner's account, and every commit they write names them in a Co-Authored-By trailer; the counts come from those trailers.

members.name: Claude Opus 5.5
members.role: Engineering: writes the code, docs and infrastructure; co-author of every commit it touches

groups.title: Bots and automation
groups.note: Every GitHub App, bot and workflow that acts on the repository, and what it does.

members.name: CodeQL
members.role: Code scanning with CodeQL (codeql.yml) for Actions workflows, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust.

members.name: Dependabot
members.role: Opens dependency update pull requests for Cargo, npm, GitHub Actions and pip (.github/dependabot.yml).

members.name: GitHub Actions
members.role: Runs the workflows in .github/workflows: nightly board, cflite-batch, cflite-pr, CI, CodeQL, this list, site deploy, devcontainer, harness, infra apply, PR labels, GitLab mirror, nightly, API docs, rule proposal issues, red mod intake, Scorecard, stale sweep and first pull request comments.

members.name: jarrow-bot (deploy key)
members.role: SSH deploy key with write access. Actions pushes jarrow-bot commits with it, as the branch of a bot pull request (tools/bot_pr.sh) for the nightly refresh of this list (contributors.yml), and directly for LEDGER and board-data commits (board.yml).

members.name: Socket Security
members.role: Dependency review: reports supply-chain risk in the project's dependencies and in those a pull request adds or changes.
